## Summary

What changed and why. Link the issue if there is one. Closes #

## Evidence

How you know it works:

- [ ] `npm run check`: the result
- [ ] `npm run validate`: the result
- [ ] Dry runs: which skill or command you ran by hand, on what, and what came out

## Docs touched

The README, `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` or skill files this change updated, or "none needed".
